thread:
Alicia Gomez: Quick sync — Sycamore week1 onboarding. Two open items before cutover: 1) audit-log schema they want, 2) KMS rotation/ownership. Can folks confirm today?

Devin Park: Got it. Can you paste the exact audit log sample they expect? I remember something about JSONL envelopes.

Alicia Gomez: Yep — they sent this example.
```json
{"envelope_id":"env_01","timestamp":"2026-03-19T14:02:11Z","service":"redwood-private","user_id":"user-123","request_id":"req-abc","payload":{"model":"gpt-4-x","input_tokens":45},"sensitive_masked":true}
```

Matt Chen: Thanks. A couple questions: who owns the KMS key? Do they require CMK in their account vs our managed key? Also rotation cadence?

Alicia Gomez: They require customer-managed CMK in their AWS account (they're doing cross-account CMKs). Rotation: 90-day preferred, but they asked if we can support automated rotation + key aliasing so key ARN doesn't change in configs. HSM is optional but they'd like KMS key policy that limits Admins to their security team only.

Kai - Solutions: Network note — Sycamore has a strict egress policy: only 3 static IPs allowed. Options: 1) NAT gateway with Elastic IPs in their VPC and route Redwoods outbound through that (preferred), or 2) proxy through partner. Either way we need to document the egress IPs on our end.

Devin Park: We'll add an explicit runbook step to require static egress IPs and where to add them in their firewall. Also update TLS cert rotation step since certs are pinned to our endpoint.

Alicia Gomez: Adding runbook items now. Also need the exact service account ARN they'll allow to call the Private API. Here's our recommended minimal IAM policy to attach to their role (they'll use a cross-account role):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-onboarded"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"}
  ]
}
```

Sam (security-bot): Security checklist reminders: - Audit logs must include user_id + request_id + timestamp; no raw PII in payloads (mask on ingestion). - Ensure KMS key policy restricts key usage to their account + our service principal only. - Add Splunk/Enterprise log forwarder endpoint in runbook step 5.

Matt Chen: Can we get a quick 15-min call to confirm the KMS policy and static IP approach? I have a slot at 15:30 PT.

Alicia Gomez: 15:30 PT works for me. Sending calendar invite now. :calendar:

ops-bot: onboarding-checklist updated by Devin Park — added "static-egress-ips" and "cmk-rotation-90d" steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Sycamore/runbook (internal)

Devin Park: I'll follow up after the call with the exact runbook diff and the policy docs to email to their security team. :white_check_mark:

Alicia Gomez: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll capture any post-call changes here and drive the handoff to engineering for the cutover window.
